markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (95%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, model consensus, and benign stroma support Normal with 2% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 95%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 2%, Benign 1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | Normal (90% coverage, 10% alpha) | Single class at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Passes QC; extreme OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (83%–85% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous reference neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (-0.683, +0.392 shift); 12/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Typical (0.362, -0.244 shift); 19/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.072, -0.243 shift); 20/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Low (0.286, -0.189 shift); 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); mitoses and normal lobules (0/20 spot-checks) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 resample degradation (100th OOD percentile) masks atypia; contrast case BACH_0320 (InSitu, 77% similarity) differs in pleomorphism.
- Medial margin segments (y=512–1024, up to 100% score vs 0.999823 threshold) harbor true margin involvement [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 1**: Inspect highest heatmap risk area (15% risk) for occult invasive carcinoma or resampling artifact.
2. **Regions 4, 8**: Check medial margin segments (93%–100% margin score) and region 4 nuclear pleomorphism.
3. **Regions 7, 11**: Verify ductal architecture in region 11 and second-highest heatmap risk (5%) in region 7.
